narration.text: It's early on February 12. A stack of mail sits on the counter.
Piper turned 55, and Beth was not at the table.

opening.text: I've been wanting to bring up Beth, if that's alright.
Beth is only in St. Mary's County, and we hardly see them. Would you reach out and visit?

choices.text: Yes. Beth should hear from me, and I'd rather it was soon.

lines.text: Thank you. Beth will be glad to hear from you.

choices.text: Why now? What made you think of Beth?

lines.text: Start with how Beth is. You don't have to start with the old things.

choices.text: Alright, I can do that much. I'll let Beth know I was thinking of them.

lines.text: I'm glad. It'll mean a lot to Beth.

choices.text: I understand what you're asking. My answer about Beth is still no for now.

lines.text: Can you tell me what's in the way with Beth?

choices.text: Fine, I'll do it. I've let Beth go too long without a word.

lines.text: Thank you for that. Beth has been missed.

choices.text: I need to think about what I'd even say to Beth. Let me do that first.

close.speaker: Henry Li
close.text: Think about it. I'd still like Beth to hear from you.

choices.text: That's not mine to fix. Beth knows where I am.

lines.text: Even a short note to Beth? It doesn't have to be much.

choices.text: Alright, yes. Beth shouldn't have to wait on me.

lines.text: Thank you for that. Beth has been missed.

choices.text: Give me some time with this one. Beth won't be fixed in a conversation.

close.speaker: Henry Li
close.text: No rush. Just don't let Beth wait too long.
